text: Scientific claim verification requires linking natural language assertions to supporting or refuting passages in published literature. The rest of this paper is organized as follows in Sections 2 through 5. In this study, we introduce SciBERT, a pretrained language model trained on 1.14 million papers from Semantic Scholar. Experimental results demonstrate that SciBERT achieves statistically significant improvements over BERT-Base across biomedical and computer science NLP benchmarks. Figure 1: Overview of the SciBERT pretraining pipeline. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/allenai/scibert.
gold_claims: Experimental results demonstrate that SciBERT achieves statistically significant improvements over BERT-Base across biomedical and computer science NLP benchmarks.

text:
Can dense sentence embeddings replace lexical BM25 retrieval for scientific passages? All models were implemented in PyTorch and trained on a single workstation with 32 GB RAM. Our evaluation shows that Sentence-BERT reduces semantic similarity search time from 65 hours to approximately 5 seconds while maintaining accuracy. Furthermore, cross-encoder reranking after bi-encoder retrieval improves top-5 recall by 14.2% on FEVER. Table 2: Hyperparameter settings used during training. References
[1] Reimers and Gurevych. Sentence-BERT. EMNLP 2019.
gold_claims: Our evaluation shows that Sentence-BERT reduces semantic similarity search time from 65 hours to approximately 5 seconds while maintaining accuracy.
Furthermore, cross-encoder reranking after bi-encoder retrieval improves top-5 recall by 14.2% on FEVER.

text: FEVER is a large-scale benchmark containing 185,445 claims derived from Wikipedia articles. Section 3 describes the annotation protocol and inter-annotator agreement procedure. Error analysis indicates that document and sentence retrieval failures account for over 60% of end-to-end verification errors. In contrast, oracle evidence experiments confirm that neural NLI classifiers exceed 88% accuracy when given gold passages. Acknowledgements: This work was funded by a university research fellowship.
gold_claims: Error analysis indicates that document and sentence retrieval failures account for over 60% of end-to-end verification errors.
In contrast, oracle evidence experiments confirm that neural NLI classifiers exceed 88% accuracy when given gold passages.

text: Participants were recruited from four outpatient clinics between January 2021 and December 2023. Serum vitamin D concentrations were measured at baseline and week 12 using mass spectrometry. Daily vitamin D supplementation significantly reduced the risk of acute respiratory tract infection among adults with severe baseline deficiency (p < 0.01). However, monthly bolus dosing did not reduce infection incidence compared with placebo in vitamin-replete participants. Figure 2: CONSORT flow diagram of trial enrollment.
gold_claims: Daily vitamin D supplementation significantly reduced the risk of acute respiratory tract infection among adults with severe baseline deficiency (p < 0.01).
However, monthly bolus dosing did not reduce infection incidence compared with placebo in vitamin-replete participants.

text: Large language models are increasingly adopted for automated literature review workflows. In this section we outline our taxonomy of generation errors and evaluation prompts. Empirical benchmarks reveal that retrieval-augmented generation reduces factual errors on closed-domain QA yet still exhibits faithfulness hallucinations when citations are unchecked. Moreover, long-form atomic fact audits show that even frontier models hallucinate between 3% and 86% of generated facts depending on domain specificity. See Appendix B for full prompt templates.
gold_claims: Empirical benchmarks reveal that retrieval-augmented generation reduces factual errors on closed-domain QA yet still exhibits faithfulness hallucinations when citations are unchecked.
Moreover, long-form atomic fact audits show that even frontier models hallucinate between 3% and 86% of generated facts depending on domain specificity.

text: Mice were housed under a 12-hour light-dark cycle with standard laboratory chow and water. Liver tissue samples were collected after 16 hours of fasting for transcriptomic profiling. Our biochemical assays demonstrate that metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I activity and suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis in diabetic mice. Conversely, supraphysiological concentrations were not required to trigger AMPK activation in primary hepatocytes. Table 1: Primer sequences used for qPCR analysis.
gold_claims: Our biochemical assays demonstrate that metformin inhibits mitochondrial complex I activity and suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis in diabetic mice.
Conversely, supraphysiological concentrations were not required to trigger AMPK activation in primary hepatocytes.

text: Does moderate aerobic training lower blood pressure without pharmacological intervention? Eligible adults completed a 12-week supervised treadmill protocol three times per week. Randomized trial results confirm that regular aerobic exercise decreased systolic blood pressure by an average of 6.4 mmHg in hypertensive adults. By contrast, stretching-only control groups showed no statistically significant reduction in systolic or diastolic pressure. Correspondence should be addressed to cardiology@example.edu.
gold_claims: Randomized trial results confirm that regular aerobic exercise decreased systolic blood pressure by an average of 6.4 mmHg in hypertensive adults.
By contrast, stretching-only control groups showed no statistically significant reduction in systolic or diastolic pressure.

All models were exported to ONNX format and benchmarked on a 4-core x86 CPU. Section 4 reviews related model compression literature. Post-training 8-bit quantization reduced transformer CPU latency by 2.4x while preserving within 0.5 points of FP32 macro-F1. In addition, sorting inference batches by token length lowered padding overhead and improved throughput by 38% on DeBERTa-v3 models. References
[1] He et al. DeBERTaV3. ICLR 2023.
gold_claims: Post-training 8-bit quantization reduced transformer CPU latency by 2.4x while preserving within 0.5 points of FP32 macro-F1.
In addition, sorting inference batches by token length lowered padding overhead and improved throughput by 38% on DeBERTa-v3 models.
